script: You spent all Sunday marking order blocks. Every single one. You feel ready. Monday opens. Price taps your block perfectly. You enter. Textbook setup. Then… price blows straight through it. Every time. The fix? Before any entry, ask: where is the liquidity? The R2F Trading system checks this first. Every single trade. Stop trading blind. Follow R2F Trading. New setups every single day.
